# Context evaluation

Evaluate changes on representative tasks rather than token count alone.

Possible measures:
- task success;
- critical-constraint recall;
- correct source selection;
- tool/Skill routing;
- hallucination/conflict rate;
- resume accuracy;
- latency/cost when material.

Use paired tests where feasible:
- old context strategy;
- proposed strategy;
- same task/evidence.

A smaller prompt that loses important state is not an optimization.
